events.title: 五帝之年：禁衛軍長官萊圖斯擁立市政官佩蒂納克斯為帝
events.summary: 五帝之年：禁衛軍長官萊圖斯擁立市政官佩蒂納克斯為帝。元老院宣布康茂德為諸神之敵和國家之敵。佩蒂納克斯下令將康茂德遺體放於哈德良陵寢。萊圖斯試圖擁立執政官索修斯·法爾科為帝，被佩蒂納克斯發現後阻止。禁衛軍兵變殺死佩蒂納克斯，萊圖斯喬裝逃走。禁衛軍宣布拍賣皇位，狄狄烏斯·尤利安努斯因出價最高成為皇帝。眾元老咒罵狄狄烏斯·尤利安努斯為叛徒，狄狄烏斯·尤利安努斯命士兵襲擊元老。佩斯切尼烏斯·奈哲爾被駐敘利亞的軍團擁戴為皇帝。塞普蒂米烏斯·塞維魯於潘諾尼亞被擁立為帝並進軍羅馬。不列顛和高盧的軍隊擁戴克洛狄烏斯·阿爾比努斯為帝。元老院處死狄狄烏斯·尤利安努斯。塞普蒂米烏斯·塞維魯驅逐禁衛軍。

events.title: 新興強國弗拉基米爾－蘇茲達爾公國的大公、尤里·多爾戈魯基的長子安德烈·博戈柳布斯基進攻並洗劫基輔
events.summary: 新興強國弗拉基米爾－蘇茲達爾公國的大公、尤里·多爾戈魯基的長子安德烈·博戈柳布斯基進攻並洗劫基輔。多數羅斯大公承認他為新的大公。與先前的大公不同，安德烈一世沒有把駐地遷到基輔，而是留在弗拉基米爾，並任命弟弟格列布為基輔大公。從此基輔不再是羅斯土地的中心，政治與文化中心移到弗拉基米爾，往後的基輔大公都依附於弗拉基米爾－蘇茲達爾大公。

translation.original: Andrey Bogolyubsky, the elder son of Yuri Dolgorukiy, prince of new strong principality of Vladimir-Suzdal attacked and plundered Kiev. A majority of Russian princes recognized him as a new grand prince. Unlike previous grand princes Andrey I did not move his residence to Kiev, instead remaining in Vladimir. Andrey appointed his brother Gleb as prince of Kiev. From this time, Kiev stopped being the center of Russian lands. The political and cultural center was moved to Vladimir. New princes of Kiev became dependent on the grand princes of Vladimir-Suzdal

events.title: 在次大陸西北部發現原始人類製作的工具
events.summary: 在次大陸西北部發現原始人類製作的工具，年代可追溯到兩百萬年前。次大陸最早的考古遺址是索安河谷的舊石器時代人科遺址，索安文化遺址分布在今日印度、巴基斯坦與尼泊爾的西瓦利克地區。比姆貝特卡岩洞群中有些岩洞在十萬多年前就有直立人居住。證據顯示，直到大約七十萬年前，人科動物在印度次大陸的活動仍屬零星，到大約二十五萬年前已廣泛分布。在泰米爾納德邦清奈（舊稱馬德拉斯）附近的阿蒂蘭帕卡姆發現了馬德拉斯文化遺址，之後在這個地區的其他許多地點也發現了與這個文化相關的工具。雙面手斧與薄刃斧是這個文化典型的出土器物，另外也發現了石片工具、細石器與其他砍砸器。這些工具大多由變質岩石英岩製成，這批石器被認定屬於印度第二個間雨期。泰米爾納德邦有證據顯示，西元前 150,000 至 100,000 年間已有使用阿舍利技術的人科動物存在。

translation.original: Tools crafted by proto-humans that have been dated back two million years have been discovered in the northwestern subcontinent. The earliest archaeological site in the subcontinent is the palaeolithic hominid site in the Soan River valley. Soanian sites are found in the Sivalik region across what are now India, Pakistan, and Nepal. Some of the Bhimbetka rock shelters were inhabited by Homo erectus more than 100,000 years ago. Evidence suggested that occupation of the Indian subcontinent by hominins was sporadic until circa 700,000 years ago, and was geographically widespread by around 250,000 years ago. Madrasian culture sites have been found in Attirampakkam (Attrambakkam=13° 13' 50", 79° 53' 20"), which is located near Chennai (formerly known as Madras), Tamil Nadu. Thereafter, tools related to this culture have been found at various other locations in this region. Bifacial handaxes and cleavers are typical assemblages recovered of this culture. Flake tools, microliths and other chopping tools have also been found. Most of these tools were composed of the metamorphic rock quartzite. The stone tool artifacts in this assemblage have been identified as a part of the second inter-pluvial period in India. Evidence for presence of Hominins with Acheulean technology 150,000–100,000 BCE in Tamil Nadu.

events.title: 印度河流域文明的一個階段開始
events.summary: 印度河流域文明的一個階段開始。這個文明使用早期形式的印度河符號，今稱「印度河文字」。在接下來的一千到一千五百年間，這個文明的居民發展出手工藝（紅玉髓製品、印章雕刻）與冶金（銅、青銅、鉛、錫）的新技術，擁有精細的城市規劃、燒磚房屋、高效的排水系統、供水系統，以及成群的大型非住宅建築。這個文明相當依賴貿易，是第一個以牛車形式使用輪式運輸的文明，也使用船隻。

translation.original: Phase of the Indus Valley Civilisation begins. The civilization used an early form of the Indus signs, now called Indus script. Over the course of the next 1000–1500 years, inhabitants of the civilization developed new techniques in handicraft (carnelian products, seal carving) and metallurgy (copper, bronze, lead, and tin) had elaborate urban planning, baked brick houses, efficient drainage systems, water supply systems, and clusters of large non-residential buildings. The civilization depended significantly on trade, was the first civilization to use wheeled transport in the form of bullock carts, and also used boats.

events.title: 印度－希臘王國（又稱耶槃那王國）建立
events.summary: 印度－希臘王國（又稱耶槃那王國）建立。這是希臘化時代的希臘人王國，範圍涵蓋阿富汗部分地區與印度次大陸西北部（今巴基斯坦部分地區與印度西北部）。西元前 200 年，希臘－巴克特里亞國王德米特里一世（後來是歐克拉提德斯）從巴克特里亞入侵印度時建立了這個王國。王國存續期間先後有 30 位國王，其中最著名的是米南德一世。

translation.original: Indo-Greek Kingdom (also known as the Yavana Kingdom) is established. It was a Hellenistic-era Greek kingdom covering various parts of Afghanistan and the northwestern regions of the Indian subcontinent (parts of modern-day Pakistan and northwestern India). The kingdom was founded when the Graeco-Bactrian king Demetrius (and later Eucratides) invaded India from Bactria in 200 BCE. During its existence, the kingdom was ruled over by 30 successive kings, with Menander I being the most famous Indo-Greek king.

events.title: 古印度數學家與天文學家婆羅摩笈多完成數理天文學著作《婆羅摩修正體系》
events.summary: 古印度數學家與天文學家婆羅摩笈多完成數理天文學著作《婆羅摩修正體系》，書中說明零的作用、正負數的運算規則、計算平方根的方法、解一次與二次方程式的方法、級數求和的規則，以及婆羅摩笈多恆等式與婆羅摩笈多定理。婆羅摩笈多把重力描述為一種吸引力，主張吸引物體是地球的本性，這與亞里斯多德認為物體會尋求「自然位置」的觀點大不相同。

translation.original: Ancient Indian mathematician and astronomer Brahmagupta completes the Brāhmasphuṭasiddhānta, a text on mathematical astronomy explaining the role of zero, rules for manipulating both negative and positive numbers, a method for computing square roots, methods of solving linear and quadratic equations, and rules for summing series, Brahmagupta's identity, and Brahmagupta's theorem. Brahmagupta described gravity as a force of attraction. He posited that it is the nature of the Earth to attract objects, a significant departure from the Aristotelian view of objects seeking their "natural place".

events.summary: 拉金德拉·朱羅一世繼父親羅闍羅闍·朱羅之後成為朱羅帝國國王。他在位期間，把原本已經很遼闊的朱羅帝國勢力向北擴展到恆河岸邊，並越過海洋。拉金德拉的領土包括緬甸沿海、安達曼－尼科巴群島、拉克沙群島與馬爾地夫，他還以艦隊征服三佛齊（東南亞的蘇門答臘、爪哇與馬來半島）的國王與勃固。他擊敗孟加拉與比哈爾的波羅王朝國王摩希波羅，為紀念勝利建造新首都「恆河征服者朱羅城」。在他統治期間，朱羅成為亞洲最強大的王朝之一。泰米爾朱羅軍隊向泰國與柬埔寨高棉王國索取貢品。拉金德拉·朱羅一世是第一位率軍出海、征服這些地區的印度國王，不過碑文證據顯示帕拉瓦王朝也曾在這些地區活動。

translation.original: Rajendra Chola I became the king of Chola Empire after his father Rajaraja Chola. During his reign, he extended the influences of the already vast Chola empire up to the banks of the river Ganges in the north and across the ocean. Rajendra's territories extended coastal Burma, the Andaman and Nicobar Islands, Lakshadweep, Maldives, conquered the kings of Srivijaya (Sumatra, Java and Malay Peninsula in South East Asia) and Pegu islands with his fleet of ships. He defeated Mahipala, the Pala king of Bengal and Bihar, and to commemorate his victory he built a new capital called Gangaikonda Cholapuram. The Cholas became one of the most powerful dynasties in Asia during his reign. The Tamil Chola armies exacted tribute from Thailand and the Khmer kingdom of Cambodia. Rajendra Chola I was the first Indian king to take his armies overseas and make conquests of these territories, even though there is epigraphical evidence of Pallava presence in these very areas.

events.title: 「鍍金龍號」在 1656 年撞上今天西澳海岸小鎮西伯德和萊吉角之間的水下珊瑚礁
events.summary: 「鍍金龍號」在 1656 年撞上今天西澳海岸小鎮西伯德和萊吉角之間的水下珊瑚礁。船上有 193 名船員、八箱價值 7 萬 8600 荷蘭盾的銀幣，以及價值 10 萬 6400 荷蘭盾的貨物。193 名船員中估計有 118 人罹難。最初的 75 名倖存者，包括船長彼得·阿爾貝茨松和副舵手，帶著船上的小艇和一些沖上岸的糧食物資上了岸。船難消息傳出後，荷蘭東印度公司進行了多次救援。

translation.original: In 1656 the Vergulde Draeck struck a submerged coral reef midway between what are now the coastal towns of Seabird and Ledge Point, Western Australia. On board were 193 crew, eight boxes of silver coins worth 78,600 guilders and trade goods to the value of 106,400 guilders. Of the 193 crew, 118 are believed to have perished. The initial 75 survivors, including the ship's captain Pieter Albertszoon, and the under steersman, made it to shore. They had with them the ship's boat, a schuyt, along with a small amount of provisions and stores washed on shore. A number of rescue attempts was conducted by the Dutch East India Company once the loss was reported.

translation.original: The whole party assembled on the west side of Sydney Cove, where the deputy judge-advocate David Collins read the King's commission establishing Phillip's governorship over the colony and the letters patent establishing civil and criminal courts. Phillip addressed the convicts, wishing them ‘reformation, happiness, and prosperity, in this new country'.

translation.original: In a despatch to the under-secretary of state, Evan Nepean, Phillip recorded the rations for marines and male convicts. For seven days each received 7 pounds of bread or in lieu thereof 7 pounds of flour, 7 pounds of beef or in lieu thereof pork, 3 pints of pease, 6 ounces of butter, 1 pound of flour or in lieu thereof 12 pounds of rice. The women received two-thirds of this amount and the children generally had one-third although some received as much as the women.

translation.original: In 1281, the Thai Chiang Rai kingdom is founded and takes over power in northern Thailand.

events.title: 素可泰的蘭甘亨國王與忽必烈保持友好
events.summary: 素可泰的蘭甘亨國王與忽必烈保持友好，1282年與元朝簽訂友好條約；1294年他去世前不久親自前往中國拜見忽必烈。蒙古威脅要消滅緬甸和越南，素可泰卻因此得利；蒙古並不在意素可泰，北方後來的蘭納王國則成為緩衝國。

translation.original: King Ramkhamhaeng of Sukhothai pursues good relations with Kublai Khan and negotiates a treaty of amity with the Yuan dynasty in 1282.Ramkhamhaeng makes a personal visit to China to see Kublai Khan shortly before his death in 1294. The Mongols threaten to destroy Burma and Vietnam, but Sukhothai could prosper at their expense. The Mongols have no concern over Sukhothai and the later Lan Na Kingdom to the north is a buffer state.

translation.original: The Thai ruler Mangrai from Mueang Ngoenyang unites several principalities and conquers the Mon Kingdom Haripunjaya in 1292. This is achieved with Tai war parties of the Northern Thai people.

translation.original: The Lan Na kingdom is founded at Chiang Mai in 1292. The thriving Lan Na covers a large portion of northern Thailand and Laos which is controlled by King Mangrai.

translation.original: A border dispute between the Lan Na kingdom and the Mongols causes a war in 1296. In 1301, the Mongols carry out an expedition which ends in a Mongol disaster.

events.title: 1298年到1357年間
events.summary: 1298年到1357年間，素可泰王國逐漸衰落滅亡，羅泰則在素可泰城掌權。

translation.original: The period ranging from 1298 to 1357 is marked as the slow decline and fall of the Sukhothai kingdom when the Lo Thai are rising to power in the city of Sukhothai.

events.summary: 烏通王（拉瑪鐵菩提一世）建立阿瑜陀耶城。

translation.original: The city of Ayutthaya is founded by Uthong (Ramathibodi I).

events.title: 阿瑜陀耶建國之初建立薩迪納社會階級制度
events.summary: 阿瑜陀耶建國之初建立薩迪納社會階級制度。

translation.original: The sakdina system of social hierarchy is established at the beginning of Ayutthaya.

events.title: 拉瑪鐵菩提國王建立泰人王朝
events.summary: 拉瑪鐵菩提國王建立泰人王朝，統一阿瑜陀耶王國，之後歷代國王統治當時稱為暹羅的國家。

translation.original: A Thai monarchy is established under the rule of King Ramathibodi which unifies the Ayutthaya kingdom. A series of kings follow, ruling what was then known as Siam.

events.title: 阿瑜陀耶王國與素可泰王國競爭
events.summary: 阿瑜陀耶王國與素可泰王國競爭，逐步控制泰國，成為東南亞強權；約在1600年，阿瑜陀耶統治今日柬埔寨、寮國與緬甸的部分地區，達到最大版圖。

translation.original: The Ayutthaya kingdom rivals the Sukhothai kingdom and gradually brings Thailand under its control. Ayutthaya becomes a major power in Southeast Asia. Ayutthaya reached its greatest extent around 1600 by ruling over parts of modern-day Cambodia, Laos and Burma (Myanmar).

events.title: 阿瑜陀耶的拉梅萱王子征服北方的清邁
events.summary: 阿瑜陀耶的拉梅萱王子征服北方的清邁，以及高棉帝國舊都吳哥。

translation.original: Prince Ramesuan of Ayutthaya conquers Chiang Mai in the north and Angkor the former capital of the Khmer Empire.

translation.original: The Little Ice Age causes modest cooling in the Northern Hemisphere. The climate impact is negligible in Thailand and Southeast Asia.

events.title: 素可泰王國滅亡
events.summary: 素可泰王國滅亡，素可泰城幾乎無人居住，權力轉移到阿瑜陀耶王國，阿瑜陀耶在素可泰的廢墟上開始統治。

translation.original: The fall of the Sukhothai kingdom. Sukhothai is virtually deserted. Power shifts to the Ayutthaya Kingdom. the Ayutthaya Kingdom is established on the ruins of the Sukhothai Empire, and it is the start of their rule.

events.title: 素攀那普在1438年被阿瑜陀耶完全併吞

translation.original: The Portuguese explorer Duarte Fernandes is the first European to arrive in the Ayutthaya Kingdom in 1511. The Portuguese are theorized to have named the kingdom Siam.

events.title: 葡萄牙派使節到泰國朝廷並簽訂條約
events.summary: 葡萄牙派使節到泰國朝廷並簽訂條約。

translation.original: The Portuguese send an envoy to the Thai Court and sign a treaty.

events.title: 緬暹戰爭（1547年－1549年，又稱莽應龍戰爭）是緬甸東吁王朝與暹羅阿瑜陀耶王國的第一場戰爭
events.summary: 緬暹戰爭（1547年－1549年，又稱莽應龍戰爭）是緬甸東吁王朝與暹羅阿瑜陀耶王國的第一場戰爭，近代早期的戰法從此傳入這一帶，暹羅的素里育泰王后騎著大象戰死；緬暹戰爭一直持續到19世紀中葉。

translation.original: The Burmese–Siamese War (1547–1549) (aka the Shwehti war) was the first war fought between the Toungoo dynasty of Burma and the Ayutthaya Kingdom of Siam. Notable for the introduction of early modern warfare to the region and the Siamese Queen Suriyothai died in battle on her elephant. The Burmese–Siamese wars continued until the mid 19th century.

translation.original: The Burmese and siamese agree to a truce which ended the Shwehti war in February 1549.

events.title: 暹羅與緬甸勃固的孟族王國第一次爆發大戰
events.summary: 暹羅與緬甸勃固的孟族王國第一次爆發大戰，衝突持續到1569年。

events.title: 緬暹戰爭（1563年－1564年，又稱白象戰爭）：緬軍第二次圍攻阿瑜陀耶
events.summary: 緬暹戰爭（1563年－1564年，又稱白象戰爭）：緬軍第二次圍攻阿瑜陀耶，經過長期圍城後，阿瑜陀耶王國第一次成為東吁王朝的屬國，直到1568年。

translation.original: Burmese–Siamese War (1563–1564), (aka the War over the White Elephants), the 2nd Siege of Ayutthaya. After an extensive siege of the city of Ayutthaya, the Ayutthaya Kingdom becomes a vassal of the Toungoo dynasty for the first time. This vassal status lasts until 1568.

translation.original: The Ayutthayans revolt against the Burmese rulers and briefly regain independence.

events.title: 緬暹戰爭（1568年－1569年，又稱第一次淪陷之戰）：緬軍第三次圍攻阿瑜陀耶
events.summary: 緬暹戰爭（1568年－1569年，又稱第一次淪陷之戰）：緬軍第三次圍攻阿瑜陀耶；1568年阿瑜陀耶進攻緬甸的屬國彭世洛失敗，緬甸出兵干預，1569年8月2日打敗阿瑜陀耶，阿瑜陀耶再度成為緬甸屬國。

translation.original: Burmese–Siamese War (1568–1569), (aka the War of the first fall) the 3rd Siege of Ayutthaya. Ayutthaya unsuccessfully attacked the Burmese vassal state Phitsanulok in 1568. The Burmese responded by intervening which resulted in the defeat of Ayutthaya on 2 August 1569. Ayutthaya became a Burmese vassal state again.

translation.original: Reign of King Borommakot. It is a period of peace, and of flourishing arts and literature.

events.title: 緬暹戰爭（1759年－1760年，又稱雍籍牙戰爭）：緬軍第五次圍攻阿瑜陀耶

events.summary: 泰國第一次以民主選舉選出參議員；塔克辛·欽那瓦創立的民粹政黨泰愛泰黨贏得眾議院大選，億萬富商塔克辛當選總理，組成聯合政府。幾年內，支持塔克辛的「紅衫軍」與指控他貪腐、不忠於王室的「黃衫軍」互相對立示威，持續十年之久。

translation.original: Senators are democratically elected for the Senate for the first time. The populist Thai Rak Thai Party founded by Thaksin Shinawatra, won the national polls for the House of Representatives. Billionaire businessman Thaksin Shinawatra is elected prime minister and forms a coalition government. Within a few years, Thailand is riven by rival demonstrations between Thaksin's Red Shirt supporters and Yellow Shirt opponents, who call Thaksin corrupt and disloyal to the monarchy. These will drag on for a decade.

translation.original: In January–March 2004, martial law is imposed in largely-Muslim southern provinces after over 100 casualties in a wave of terrorist attacks which are blamed on ethnic-Malay separatists.

translation.original: Prime Minister Thaksin Shinawatra accuses several army officers of plotting to kill him after police find a car containing bomb-making materials near his house.

events.title: 塔克辛被控逃稅
events.summary: 塔克辛被控逃稅，黃衫軍在曼谷發動長達數月的大規模抗議；2006年9月至10月，軍方趁塔克辛出席聯合國大會時發動不流血政變推翻他的政府，並任命退役將領素拉育·朱拉暖為臨時總理，同時起草新憲法。

translation.original: Thaksin is accused for tax evasion. There are months of mass Yellow Shirt protests in Bangkok. In September–October 2006, military leaders stage a bloodless coup which overthrows the Thaksin administration. Meanwhile, Shinawatra is at the UN General Assembly. Retired General Surayud Chulanont is appointed interim prime minister by the military while a new constitution was drafted.

events.title: 2008年8月
events.summary: 2008年8月，塔克辛因貪汙指控未出庭，帶著家人逃到英國；他曾和妻子回到泰國，但在受審前棄保潛逃，後來被缺席判處兩年徒刑。

translation.original: In August 2008, Thaksin flees to Britain with his family after failing to appear in court to face corruption charges. Thaksin returns to Thailand with his wife, but skips bail before being tried on charges of corruption and debasement. Thaksin was sentenced to two years in jail in absentia.

events.title: 黃衫軍封鎖曼谷兩座國際機場的航廈10天
events.summary: 黃衫軍封鎖曼谷兩座國際機場的航廈10天，造成大混亂；法院解散親塔克辛的執政黨後，他們結束占領，另一個政黨組成新政府，艾比希·威差奇瓦出任總理。

translation.original: Yellow Shirt protestors block the terminals of Bangkok's two international airports for 10 days, causing widespread disruption. They end their occupation after a court dissolves the ruling pro-Thaksin party. A new government led by another party is formed. Abhisit Vejjajiva becomes prime minister.

events.title: 2010年3月至5月
events.summary: 2010年3月至5月，數萬名身穿紅衫的塔克辛支持者在曼谷市中心抗議一個多月，要求提前選舉、艾比希總理下台；經過兩個月的暴力衝突，軍隊在5月衝破抗議者的路障鎮壓，造成91人傷亡。

translation.original: In March–May 2010, mass protest of tens of thousands of Thaksin supporters - in trademark red shirts - paralyze central Bangkok with a month-long protest calling for early elections and Prime Minister Abhisit's resignation. Anti-government Red Shirts protests in central Bangkok are quelled by the army in May after two months of violence. It culminates in a crackdown by troops who storm the protesters' barricades which causes 91 casualties.

events.title: 2011年7月
events.summary: 2011年7月，親塔克辛的為泰黨在選舉中大勝，塔克辛的妹妹盈拉·欽那瓦成為泰國第一位女總理，隨後又出現更多反塔克辛的抗議。

translation.original: In July 2011, the pro-Thaksin Pheu Thai Party wins a landslide victory in the elections. Yingluck Shinawatra (sister of Thaksin Shinawatra) becomes the first female prime minister of Thailand. More anti-Thaksin protests follow.

There are 815 deaths and property damage in 65 of Thailand's 77 provinces. The estimated damage costs is 1.425 trillion baht (US$46.5 billion).

events.summary: 2016年10月，在位七十年、全世界在位最久的君主蒲美蓬·阿杜德國王去世，享年88歲。

translation.original: October 2016, King Bhumibol Adulyadej, the world's longest reigning monarch, dies at the age of 88 after 70 years on the throne.

events.summary: 2016年12月，王儲瓦吉拉隆功被宣布為國王。

events.summary: 2017年4月，瓦吉拉隆功國王簽署軍方起草的新憲法，為恢復民主鋪路。

translation.original: The Tham Luang cave rescue in June and July 2018 had a team of international rescuers save a group of young soccer players and their coach who were trapped in a flooded cave in Northern Thailand. The dramatic rescue mission involved a complex network of divers, engineers, and volunteers, and captured global attention.

translation.original: November 2019, suspected separatists kill at least 15 people in southern Thailand. This is one of the country's worst terror attacks in years.

events.title: 泰國掀起由年輕社運人士領導的反政府抗議浪潮
events.summary: 泰國掀起由年輕社運人士領導的反政府抗議浪潮，要求民主改革、結束軍方干政；當局強力鎮壓，包括逮捕抗議者並以刑罰很重的冒犯君主罪起訴。

translation.original: Thailand has a wave of anti-government protests led by young activists calling for democratic reforms and an end to military influence in politics. The protests were met with a crackdown by the authorities, including arrests and charges of lèse-majesté which carries severe penalties in Thailand.

events.summary: 內閣離他而去後，蘇哈托辭去總統，由哈比比接任。

translation.original: After being deserted by his cabinet, Suharto resigns the presidency. Habibie assumes presidency.

events.title: 維蘭托將軍宣布普拉伯沃中將退出現役
events.summary: 維蘭托將軍宣布普拉伯沃中將退出現役，保留全額退休金，也沒有因綁架和刑求學運人士的指控而接受軍事審判（到2003年仍有部分學運人士下落不明）。

translation.original: General Wiranto announces the discharge of Lieutenant General Prabowo from active duty, with full pension benefits—and without court-martial for allegations of abduction and torture of student activist (some of whom remain missing as of 2003).

events.title: 梅嘉娃蒂、賴斯和日惹蘇丹在瓦希德位於芝甘珠的家中會面
events.summary: 梅嘉娃蒂、賴斯和日惹蘇丹在瓦希德位於芝甘珠的家中會面，發表一系列聲明，包括要求軍方在六年內退出政治。

translation.original: Megawati, Rais, and the sultan of Yogya, meet at Wahid's home in Ciganjur, and issue a series of statements including a demand for the military to end their role in politics within six years.

events.title: 人民協商會議會期最後一天
events.summary: 人民協商會議會期最後一天，軍人向示威學生開槍，造成至少15人死亡、數百人受傷。

translation.original: On the last day of the MPR sessions, soldiers open fire on demonstrating students killing at least fifteen and injuring hundreds.

events.title: 安汶市的一場小爭執引發基督徒與穆斯林的衝突
events.summary: 安汶市的一場小爭執引發基督徒與穆斯林的衝突，蔓延摩鹿加各地長達三年，多達一萬人死亡，七十萬人（當地人口的三分之一）流離失所。

translation.original: A petty argument between in the city of Ambon triggers Christian-Muslim clashes that last for three years across Maluku. As many as 10,000 are killed and 700,000 or one third of the region are displaced.

events.title: 印尼舉行1955年以來第一次自由公正的全國選舉
events.summary: 印尼舉行1955年以來第一次自由公正的全國選舉，過程幾乎沒有干擾，參與踴躍；不過選票分散在48個政黨之間，沒有任何政黨過半。

translation.original: Indonesia's first free and fair national elections since 1955 take place with almost no disruption and wide participation. Votes however are distributed across forty-eight parties with no party achieving a majority.

events.title: 東帝汶在聯合國主持的公投中決定脫離印尼
events.summary: 東帝汶在聯合國主持的公投中決定脫離印尼，五分之四的選民選擇獨立；印尼武裝部隊訓練並資助的親印尼民兵立刻實施焦土政策，造成一千人死亡，大部分基礎設施被摧毀。

translation.original: Timor-Leste votes to secede from Indonesia in a referendum conducted under UN auspices. Four-fifths of voters choose independence for East Timor over integration with Indonesia. Pro-integration militias trained and paid by ABRI immediately resort to a scorched earth policy that leaves 1,000 dead and most of the territory's infrastructure ruined.

events.title: 哈比比總統屈服於國際壓力
events.summary: 哈比比總統屈服於國際壓力，同意名為「東帝汶國際部隊」的聯合國維和部隊進入東帝汶恢復秩序。

translation.original: President Habibie relents to international pressure and allows a UN peacekeeping force known as 'INTERFET' to enter East Timor and restore order.

events.title: 印尼國會否決哈比比總統的施政報告
events.summary: 印尼國會否決哈比比總統的施政報告；人民協商會議選出政黨得票只有八分之一的瓦希德為總統，政黨得票三分之一（最高）的梅嘉娃蒂當選副總統。

translation.original: The Indonesian parliament rejects President Habibie's accountability speech. Wahid whose party received one eighth of the popular vote is elected president by the MPR. Megawati whose party received one third of the vote (the highest) is elected vice president.

events.title: 瓦希德總統的政府問題重重：無法穩定經濟、政治偏袒、經濟貪腐（瓦希德本人沒有被控貪汙）、無法改革軍隊、個人行事古怪又小氣、無力處理摩鹿加和蘇拉威西的嚴重宗教暴力、加里曼丹的大規模族群暴力（達雅族對馬都拉人）
events.summary: 瓦希德總統的政府問題重重：無法穩定經濟、政治偏袒、經濟貪腐（瓦希德本人沒有被控貪汙）、無法改革軍隊、個人行事古怪又小氣、無力處理摩鹿加和蘇拉威西的嚴重宗教暴力、加里曼丹的大規模族群暴力（達雅族對馬都拉人），以及亞齊和伊里安查亞的分離運動。

translation.original: President Wahid's administration is marred by failures to stabilise the economy, patterns of political favouritism, economic corruption (although Wahid himself is not accused of corruption), inability to reform the military, personal eccentricity and pettiness, ineffectiveness in dealing with major religious violence in Maluku and Sulawesi, major ethnic violence (Dayaks vs. Madurese) in Kalimantan, and separatisms in Aceh and Irian Jaya.

events.summary: 全國三十多處地點同時發生協同攻擊，教堂遭炸彈攻擊，18人死亡；後來證實是伊斯蘭祈禱團策劃的，目的是報復摩鹿加衝突中基督徒殺害穆斯林。

translation.original: In a coordinated attack involving more than three dozen sites across the country, churches are bombed and eighteen people killed. It is later proven to have been planned by Jemaah Islamiyah in retaliation for Christian killings of Muslims in the Maluku conflict.

events.title: 加里曼丹發生族群暴力
events.summary: 加里曼丹發生族群暴力，原住民達雅族驅逐馬都拉移民；瓦希德的支持者和反對者發動大規模政治示威；國際貨幣基金以打擊貪腐缺乏進展為由，停止繼續貸款。

translation.original: Ethnic violence in Kalimantan as indigenous Dayaks force out Madurese transmigrants. Mass political demonstrations by Wahid's supporters and opponents. IMF stops further loans citing lack of progress in tackling corruption.

events.title: 瓦希德總統主要因為不適任而遭罷免
events.summary: 瓦希德總統主要因為不適任而遭罷免，國會以592票對0票選出梅嘉娃蒂為總統；哈姆扎·哈茲擊敗阿克巴·丹戎與退役中將蘇西洛·班邦·尤多約諾，當選副總統。

translation.original: President Wahid is impeached chiefly on grounds of incompetence. The parliament elects Megawati president by 592 votes to 0. Hamzah Haz defeats Akbar Tandjung and Lieutenant General (ret.) Susilo Bambang Yudhoyono.

events.title: 梅嘉娃蒂總統在九一一恐怖攻擊一週後拜會小布希總統
events.summary: 梅嘉娃蒂總統在九一一恐怖攻擊一週後拜會小布希總統，歡迎美國投資；回國後，伊斯蘭右派批評她配合美國的阿富汗戰爭，民族主義左派則批評她對外國投資人太過順從。

translation.original: President Megawati visits President George Bush a week after the 9/11 terrorist attacks and welcomes American investment. On her return to Indonesia, the Islamic right criticises her cooperation with America's war in Afghanistan, and the nationalist left criticises here for being too suppliant to foreign investors.

events.title: 菲律賓開始採礦
events.summary: 菲律賓開始採礦，早期菲律賓人開採金、銀、銅、鐵等礦；珠寶、金條、鍊子、手鐲和耳環代代相傳，人們也使用金質短劍柄、金盤、包金牙齒和大型黃金飾品。

translation.original: First mining in the Philippines began. The early Filipinos worked various mines of gold, silver, copper and iron. Jewels, gold ingots, chains, calombigas and earrings were handed down from antiquity and inherited from their ancestors. Gold dagger handles, gold dishes, tooth plating, and huge gold ornaments were also used.

events.title: 沙黃文化：在利普恩角塔邦洞群的瑪農古爾洞新石器時代墓地出土的二次葬陶罐「瑪農古爾罐」
events.summary: 沙黃文化：在利普恩角塔邦洞群的瑪農古爾洞新石器時代墓地出土的二次葬陶罐「瑪農古爾罐」，罐蓋上的海浪圖案顯示它屬於沙黃文化的陶器傳統；這些人從婆羅洲－巴拉望一帶由東向西遷到越南南部。

translation.original: The Sa Huỳnh culture, evidence can be found in Manunggul Jar which is a secondary burial jar excavated from a Neolithic burial site in Manunggul cave of Tabon Caves at Lipuun Point. The depiction of sea-waves on the lid places this Manunggul jar in the Sa Huỳnh culture pottery tradition. These are people that migrated in an East to West migration from the Borneo-Palawan area to Southern Vietnam.

events.title: 較大的村落出現
events.summary: 較大的村落出現，通常靠近水邊，方便交通和貿易；村落之間來往容易，開始有相似的文化特徵，這在過去只有小型親族團體時是不可能的。

translation.original: Larger villages came about- usually based near water, which made traveling and trading easier. The resulting ease of contact between communities meant that they began to share similar cultural traits, something which had not previously been possible when the communities consisted only of small kinship groups.

events.title: 麥圖姆陶罐是人形陶罐
events.summary: 麥圖姆陶罐是人形陶罐，造型像小孩（罐蓋是頭，有耳朵，罐身是身體，手腳做成把手），上有紅黑兩色的穿孔，在薩蘭加尼省麥圖姆皮諾爾的阿尤布洞作為二次葬陶罐，每個陶罐都有不同的「表情」，是菲律賓喪葬陶器的另一個例子。

translation.original: The Maitum Jars are anthropomorphic jars that were depicting children (head is the lead of the jar with ears and the body was the jar itself with hands and feet as the handle) with perforations in red and black colors, had been used as a secondary burial jars in Ayub Cave, Pinol, Maitum Sarangani province, each of the jars had a "facial expression". Another example of funeral pottery in the Philippines.

events.title: 至少從3世紀起
events.summary: 至少從3世紀起，菲律賓原住民就與東南亞和東亞其他國家往來；分散的族群融合許多稱為「巴朗蓋」的小型政治單位，建立了許多城邦；每個巴朗蓋由「達圖」（首領，至今仍在非西班牙化的菲律賓族群中使用）領導，再向稱為「拉坎」或「拉惹」的國王負責。

translation.original: Since at least the 3rd century, the indigenous peoples were in contact with other Southeast Asian and East Asian nations. Fragmented ethnic groups established numerous city-states formed by the assimilation of several small political units known as barangay each headed by a Datu or headman (still in use among non-Hispanic Filipino ethnic groups) and answerable to a king, titled Lakan and Rajah.

events.title: 第二次人民力量革命（EDSA II）推翻艾斯特拉達總統
events.summary: 第二次人民力量革命（EDSA II）推翻艾斯特拉達總統，副總統葛洛麗亞·馬嘉柏皋·艾若育成為菲律賓第14任總統，也是第二位女總統；1月16日參議員以11比10投票不開啟第二個證據信封後檢察官退席，群眾聚集人民力量聖殿要求總統下台；1月20日艾斯特拉達辭職離開馬拉坎南宮，艾若育由首席大法官達維德監誓就職。

translation.original: EDSA II Revolution ousts Pres. Estrada; Vice-Pres. Gloria Macapagal Arroyo becomes the 14th president of the Philippines. January 16 – Prosecutors of the trial walk out after senators voted, 11–10, not to open the second envelope containing the documents of evidences against Pres. Estrada, regarding his supposed link to a bank account purportedly containing kickbacks from an illegal numbers game; crowd start to gather in the People Power Shrine and conduct the mass rallies, calling for his resignation. January 17 – Impeachment trial aborted. January 19 – High-ranking military and police officials, including Defense Secy. Orlando Mercado, AFP Chief of Staff Gen. Angelo Reyes and PNP Chief Dir. Gen. Panfilo Lacson, withdraw from the Estrada administration. January 20 – Pres. Estrada resigns and leaves Malacañang. Vice-Pres. Macapagal Arroyo is sworn into office by Chief Justice Davide at Our Lady of EDSA Shrine in Mandaluyong; thus, the nation's second woman President.

translation.original: Slavery is abolished in East Africa Witchcraft is illegal in East Africa Nabongo Mumia is appointed Paramount Chief of Sub-District No. 1 by the colonial administration, with administrative authority under both the East Africa Protectorate and the Uganda Protectorate. The territories placed under his jurisdiction encompass much of the Wanga Kingdom and extended from present-day Naivasha in Kenya to Jinja in present-day Uganda. The appointment over an expansive administrative region consolidates the Wanga Kingdom's position as a leading political, economic, military and administrative centre in Kenya. The appointment recognizes his alliance with the British colonial administration, expands his authority over numerous communities, and further consolidating the Wanga Kingdom as one of as one of the principal African administrative authorities in colonial Kenya.

translation.original: The British East African Protectorate is transformed to the Kenya Colony Young Kikuyu Association is started by Harry Thuku. Advocating for African suffrage, he was inspired to start a nationalist movement. Thuku renamed his organisation the East African Association, as he was striving for multi-ethnic membership. He included the local Indian community and reached out to other tribes. The colonial government accused Thuku of sedition, arrested him and detained him until 1930. Kikuyu Central Association is formed Led by Joseph Keng'ethe and Jesse Kariuki. Johnstone (later Jomo) Kenyatta was the secretary and editor of the associations' publication Mugwithania (The unifier). Sir Edward Northey becomes the first Kenyan ruler (governor)

The best known memory device from this region still in use is the Lukasa memory board from the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

translation.original: Nabongo Mumia dies at about the age of 100, marking the end of the Wanga Kingdom's prominence as a principal African administrative authority in Kenya under British colonial rule. Governor Philip Mitchell attends the funeral. Following Nabongo Mumia's death, the British colonial government declined to recognize a royal successor to the Paramount Chieftainship,effectively dismantling the political institution of the Wanga Kingdom favoring bureaucratic rule over hereditary cheftainship.

translation.original: George VI dies, Elizabeth II ascends the throne while on a royal tour in Kenya Jomo Kenyatta visits Kisumu in an effort to gain nationwide support for KAU. This visit inspires Oginga Odinga, the Ker (Chief) of the Luo Union, to join KAU. Multiracial pattern of quotas allowed Mau Mau Uprising begins Members of the Forty group, a militant group of World War II veterans including Bildad Kaggia, form part of the core leadership of the uprising.

translation.original: The Kennedy Airlift scholarship program is started by Tom Mboya and William X Scheinman to address the shortfall of skilled African labour in soon to be independent Kenya. Nobel Prize winner Wangarĩ Maathai, Barack Obama Sr. and George Saitoti are amongst the beneficiaries of these airlifts. The program lasts until 1963. Over 800 students from East Africa benefit from this program.

translation.original: The colonial government attempts to crush Tom Mboya's Nairobi People's Convention Party. This is the most organised and effective political party in Kenya at a time when national African parties are banned. Mboya's home is raided by the police and over 40 party members are arrested and sent to their tribal homes. This is the biggest round up since the Mau Mau emergency.

events.summary: 2017年肯亞大選舉行，選前九天，獨立選舉與選區劃分委員會資訊主管克里斯·姆桑多被發現遭謀殺；選舉被控作票，爭議激烈，執政的禧年黨候選人烏胡魯·肯亞塔被宣布勝選，橙色民主運動領袖拉伊拉·奧廷加向最高法院提出異議；奈洛比、肯亞西部和沿海地區爆發抗議，警方致命鎮壓，選後幾週至少12人死亡、上百人受傷，6個月大的女嬰薩曼莎·彭多慘死，引發社會對警察暴力的強烈憤慨。

translation.original: The 2017 Kenyan general elections are held. Nine days prior to the election, Chris Msando, the head of IT at the Independent Electoral and Boundaries Commission is found murdered. The election is highly contested with allegations of rigging. The incumbent, Jubilee Party candidate Uhuru Kenyatta, is declared winner but the results are challenged in the Supreme Court by Raila Odinga, leader of the Orange Democratic Movement Afterwards, protests erupt in Nairobi, Western Kenya and the Coastal region. The police response is lethal. Over the next weeks after the election, at least 12 people are killed and over a hundred injured. Police operations include door to door crackdowns in areas not involved in the protests. The tragic death of 6 month old Samantha Pendo ignites an uproar over police brutality.

events.title: 民族大遷徙時期
events.summary: 民族大遷徙時期，蘇維匯人以布拉加為首都建立蘇維匯王國，國王赫梅里克信仰日耳曼多神教；汪達爾人和阿蘭人也進入今天的葡萄牙地區。

translation.original: In the context of the Migration Period, the Kingdom of the Suebi is established with King Hermeric, a believer of Germanic paganism, as its leader and Braga as its capital. The Kingdom includes Gallaecia and varying other parts of Portugal. Other groups that enter the Portuguese area are the Germanic Vandals, led by Gunderic, and the Iranic Alans, led by Respendial.

loc.title: Wikidata：汪达尔人

events.title: 西羅馬帝國委託西哥德人
events.summary: 西羅馬帝國委託西哥德人，從蘇維匯人和阿蘭人手中奪回西班牙（第一次哥德戰爭）。

translation.original: In the first Gothic War in Spain (416–418), the Western Roman Empire commissions the Visigoths to take back Spain for the Roman Empire from the Suebi and Alans.

events.title: 第一次哥德戰爭結束
events.summary: 第一次哥德戰爭結束，西哥德人與羅馬奪回伊比利半島大部分地區，蘇維匯王國只剩西北部的加利西亞；阿蘭人國王戰死，阿蘭人改奉汪達爾國王為王。

translation.original: The first Gothic War in Spain ends, with a win for the Visigoths and Rome, who take back a considerable portion of the Iberian Peninsula, with the Kingdom of Suebi being restricted to the North of Spain (Gallecia). Attaces, who had taken over leadership of the Alans from Respendial (date unknown), is killed in battle. The Alans appealed to Gunderic, King of the Vandals, who then became also king of the Alans.

events.title: 蘇維匯國王赫梅里克的女兒嫁給阿蘭國王
events.summary: 蘇維匯國王赫梅里克的女兒嫁給阿蘭國王，作為在科英布拉一戰後的和約。

translation.original: Cindazunda, daughter of King Hermeric, marries Attaces, King of the Alans as part of a peace deal after a battle in Coimbra.

loc.title: Wikidata：科英布拉
loc.note: 依原文提到的條目推算位置

events.title: 羅馬將領阿斯特里烏斯在加利西亞平定叛亂
events.summary: 羅馬將領阿斯特里烏斯在加利西亞平定叛亂，並介入蘇維匯人與汪達爾人、阿蘭人之間的戰爭。

translation.original: Asterius, a Roman general, campaigns in Gallecia to suppress an uprising by Maximus and a war between Suebi against the Vandals and Alans.

events.title: 汪達爾國王去世
events.summary: 汪達爾國王去世，同父異母的弟弟蓋薩里克成為汪達爾與阿蘭國王。

translation.original: Following Gunderic's death, Gaiseric, his half-brother, becomes King of the Vandals and Alans.

events.title: 蓋薩里克率領汪達爾人和阿蘭人離開伊比利半島前往北非
events.summary: 蓋薩里克率領汪達爾人和阿蘭人離開伊比利半島前往北非，後來他們征服地中海許多島嶼，還洗劫羅馬，但再也沒有回到伊比利半島。

translation.original: Gaiseric leads the Vandals and Alans out of Iberia and into North Africa. They would later conquer many islands in the Mediterranean Sea and go on to sack Rome but would not return to Iberia.

loc.title: Wikidata：地中海
loc.note: 依原文提到的條目推算位置

events.title: 蘇維匯國王雷希拉多次出兵攻打羅馬人和西哥德人
events.summary: 蘇維匯國王雷希拉多次出兵攻打羅馬人和西哥德人。

translation.original: Rechila, King of the Suebi, leads several campaigns against the Romans and Visigoths.

events.title: 盧西塔尼亞首府梅里達被蘇維匯國王攻下
events.summary: 盧西塔尼亞首府梅里達被蘇維匯國王攻下，結束了羅馬在當地的統治。

translation.original: Emerita Augusta, capital of Lusitania, is captured by Recila, ending its Roman rule.

events.title: 第二次哥德戰爭：蘇維匯人對抗羅馬、西哥德、法蘭克與勃艮第聯軍
events.summary: 第二次哥德戰爭：蘇維匯人對抗羅馬、西哥德、法蘭克與勃艮第聯軍，蘇維匯國王逃到波多後被殺，布拉加等城市遭洗劫。

translation.original: The second Gothic War in Spain (456) takes place between the Suebi (led by Rechila's son, Rechiar) and the Romans, Visigoths, Franks and Burgundians. Rechiar flees to Porto, where he is killed. The Battle of Órbigo culminates with the sacking of (Suebi) Braga and nearby cities.

loc.title: Wikidata：勃艮第人
loc.note: 依原文提到的條目推算位置

events.title: 主教伊達修斯完成拉丁文編年史
events.summary: 主教伊達修斯完成拉丁文編年史，是 427 到 468 年間伊比利半島歷史唯一的同時代史料。

translation.original: Hydatius, bishop of Aquae Flaviae, finishes writing his Chronicon, a chronicle written in Latin which is our only contemporary source for the history of Hispania between 427 and 468.

loc.title: Wikidata：阿卡耶·弗拉維亞耶
loc.note: 依原文提到的條目推算位置

events.title: 西哥德國王阿拉里克二世頒布《阿拉里克法律要略》
events.summary: 西哥德國王阿拉里克二世頒布《阿拉里克法律要略》，這部羅馬法匯編適用於西哥德統治下的羅馬居民，而不是西哥德貴族。

translation.original: The Breviary of Alaric is published by the order of Alaric II, King of the Visigoths. This collection of Roman law applied, not to the Visigothic nobles who lived under their own law, but to the Hispano-Roman and Gallo-Roman population, living under Visigoth rule.

events.title: 布拉加的馬丁約在這一年來到加利西亞
events.summary: 布拉加的馬丁約在這一年來到加利西亞，他在蘇維匯人從亞流派改信正統基督教的過程中扮演重要角色。

translation.original: Around this year, Martin of Braga, who played an important role in the conversion of the Suevi from Arianism to Chalcedonianism, settles in Gallecia.

events.title: 拜占庭皇帝查士丁尼一世設立西班牙行省
events.summary: 拜占庭皇帝查士丁尼一世設立西班牙行省，最大時包括今天的阿爾加維部分地區。

translation.original: Emperor Justinian I, of the Byzantine Empire, establishes the province of Spania. In its greatest extent, Spania would include parts of modern-day Algarve.

loc.title: Wikidata：西班尼亞
loc.note: 依原文提到的條目推算位置

events.title: 第一次布拉加會議召開
events.summary: 第一次布拉加會議召開，譴責當時在西班牙出現的基督教派別普里西利安派。

translation.original: The First Council of Braga takes place, taking aim at Priscillianism, a Christian sect that had emerged in Spain.

loc.title: Wikidata：First Council of Braga
loc.note: 依原文提到的條目推算位置

events.title: 信仰亞流派的西哥德國王萊奧維吉爾德征服蘇維匯王國
events.summary: 信仰亞流派的西哥德國王萊奧維吉爾德征服蘇維匯王國，控制伊比利半島大部分地區（包括葡萄牙全境）。

translation.original: King Liuvigild of the Visigothic Kingdom (capital in Toletum), an Arian, conquers the Suevi Kingdom, thus controlling most of the Iberian Peninsula (and all of Portugal).

loc.title: Wikidata：托萊多
loc.note: 依原文提到的條目推算位置

events.title: 萊奧維吉爾德去世
events.summary: 萊奧維吉爾德去世，由兒子雷卡雷德一世繼位。

translation.original: King Liuvigild dies and is followed by his son, Reccared I.

events.title: 雷卡雷德一世放棄亞流派、改信正統基督教
events.summary: 雷卡雷德一世放棄亞流派、改信正統基督教，並平定國內幾次亞流派叛亂。

translation.original: King Reccared I renounces Arianism for Chalcedonianism and suppresses several Arian revolts in his kingdom.

events.title: 第三次托雷多會議
events.summary: 第三次托雷多會議，西哥德王國加入天主教會，維塞烏和波多的主教都出席。

translation.original: In the Third Council of Toledo, the Visigothic Kingdom joins the Catholic Church. The bishops of Viseu and of Porto attend the council.

loc.title: Wikidata：Third Council of Toledo
loc.note: 依原文提到的條目推算位置

events.title: 雷卡雷德一世去世
events.summary: 雷卡雷德一世去世，由兒子利烏瓦二世繼位。

translation.original: King Reccared I dies and is succeeded by his son, Liuva II.

events.title: 曾參與亞流派叛亂的維特里克奉命率西哥德軍隊對抗拜占庭
events.summary: 曾參與亞流派叛亂的維特里克奉命率西哥德軍隊對抗拜占庭，卻殺了利烏瓦二世，自立為西哥德國王。

translation.original: Witteric, who had been involved as a conspirator in the Arian uprisings of 585, is given command to lead the Visigothic army against the Byzantine Empire. Instead, he has Liuva II executed and becomes King of the Visigoths.

events.title: 維特里克被一群天主教貴族殺害
events.summary: 維特里克被一群天主教貴族殺害，他們擁立貢德馬爾為西哥德國王。

translation.original: King Witteric is murdered by a faction of Catholic nobles. They proclaim Gundemar as King of the Visigoths.

events.title: 貢德馬爾自然死亡
events.summary: 貢德馬爾自然死亡，由西塞布特繼位；西塞布特從拜占庭手中奪回西班牙行省大部分地區（阿爾加維除外），並迫害猶太人。

translation.original: King Gundemar dies of natural causes. He is succeeded by Sisebut. He took back most of the province of Spania from Byzantine control, except for the Algarve and would persecute Jews.

loc.title: Wikidata：阿爾加維
loc.note: 依原文提到的條目推算位置

events.title: 西塞布特去世
events.summary: 西塞布特去世，年幼的兒子即位為雷卡雷德二世，在位時間從幾天到一年多說法不一；雷卡雷德二世死後由雷卡雷德一世的兒子蘇因蒂拉繼位。

translation.original: Upon the death of King Sisebut, his young son takes the throne as Reccared II. The length of the reign exactly is debated to last from several days to just over a year, Reccared II dies and Suintila, son of Reccared I, takes the throne.

events.title: 蘇因蒂拉奪回阿爾加維
events.summary: 蘇因蒂拉奪回阿爾加維，拜占庭在伊比利半島的勢力就此結束。

translation.original: King Suintila takes back Algarve, ending the Byzantine presence in Iberia.

events.title: 貴族與教士因土地沒收與特權分配不滿而叛亂
events.summary: 貴族與教士因土地沒收與特權分配不滿而叛亂，蘇因蒂拉被廢，西塞南德自立為西哥德國王。

translation.original: A rebellion over confiscations of lands and distribution of privileges between the nobility and clergy results in King Suintila being deposed and Sisenand proclaiming himself King of the Visigoths.

events.title: 伊烏迪拉在國內起事失敗
events.summary: 伊烏迪拉在國內起事失敗，後來被殺。

translation.original: There was an attempted uprising within the kingdom, led by Iudila, but the revolution failed and Iudila was later killed.

events.title: 西塞南德召開第四次托雷多會議
events.summary: 西塞南德召開第四次托雷多會議，會議沒有給予他世襲王位的權利。

translation.original: King Sisenand convened the IV Council of Toledo. The Council did not grant him hereditary rights.

loc.title: Wikidata：Fourth Council of Toledo
loc.note: 依原文提到的條目推算位置

events.title: 西塞南德自然死亡
events.summary: 西塞南德自然死亡，由欽蒂拉繼位。

translation.original: King Sisenand dies of natural causes, Chintila succeeds him.

events.title: 欽蒂拉召開第五次托雷多會議
events.summary: 欽蒂拉召開第五次托雷多會議，想穩定政局。

translation.original: King Chintilla convenes the Fifth Council of Toledo in an attempt to bring political stability.

loc.title: Wikidata：Church of Santa Leocadia, Toledo
loc.note: 依原文提到的條目推算位置

events.title: 欽蒂拉召開第六次托雷多會議
events.summary: 欽蒂拉召開第六次托雷多會議，再一次想穩定國內情勢。

translation.original: King Chintilla convenes the Sixth Council of Toledo in a second attempt to create internal stability.

events.title: 欽蒂拉去世
events.summary: 欽蒂拉去世，由兒子圖爾加繼位。

translation.original: King Chintilla dies and is succeeded by his son Tulga.

events.title: 曾隨萊奧維吉爾德作戰的老將欽達斯溫特被西哥德貴族選為國王
events.summary: 曾隨萊奧維吉爾德作戰的老將欽達斯溫特被西哥德貴族選為國王。

translation.original: Chindasuinth, a veteran of the Liuvigild campaigns, is elected by the Visigothic nobles as the King of the Visigoths.

events.title: 欽達斯溫特召開第七次托雷多會議
events.summary: 欽達斯溫特召開第七次托雷多會議，主要是加重叛國罪的刑罰。

translation.original: King Chindasuinth convenes the Seventh Council of Toledo. Its main aim was to further harden the laws against treason.

events.title: 欽達斯溫特立兒子雷切斯溫特為共治國王
events.summary: 欽達斯溫特立兒子雷切斯溫特為共治國王，又一次想在西哥德王國建立世襲王位。

translation.original: King Chindasuinth proclaims his son, Recceswinth, as co-king in yet another attempt to establish a hereditary monarchy in the Visigothic Kingdom.

events.title: 欽達斯溫特父子召開第八次托雷多會議
events.summary: 欽達斯溫特父子召開第八次托雷多會議。

translation.original: King Chindasuinth, and his co-king son, convene the Eighth Council of Toledo.

events.title: 欽達斯溫特去世
events.summary: 欽達斯溫特去世，雷切斯溫特成為唯一的國王。

translation.original: King Chindasuinth dies, leaving his son Recceswinth as sole king.

events.title: 雷切斯溫特頒布《西哥德法典》
events.summary: 雷切斯溫特頒布《西哥德法典》，廢除羅馬人和西哥德人各用不同法律的舊傳統，從此王國所有人民都不再分羅馬人或哥德人，而一律是「西班牙人」。

translation.original: King Recceswinth published the Visigothic Code, which abolished the old tradition of having different laws for Romans (leges romanae) and Visigoths (leges barbarorum), and under it all the subjects of the Visigothic kingdom would stop being romani and gothi instead becoming hispani.

events.title: 雷切斯溫特召開第十次托雷多會議
events.summary: 雷切斯溫特召開第十次托雷多會議。

translation.original: King Recceswinth summons the Tenth Council of Toledo.

events.title: 雷切斯溫特去世
events.summary: 雷切斯溫特去世，由萬巴繼位，萬巴後來成功平定尼姆的伊爾德里克叛亂。

translation.original: King Recceswinth dies and is succeeded by Wamba. He would face a revolt from Hilderic of Nîmes that he would successfully deal with.

events.title: 第三次布拉加會議和第十一次托雷多會議召開
events.summary: 第三次布拉加會議和第十一次托雷多會議召開。

translation.original: The Third Council of Braga and the Eleventh Council of Toledo are held.

loc.title: Wikidata：布拉加
loc.note: 依原文提到的條目推算位置

events.title: 埃爾維格接替萬巴成為西哥德國王
events.summary: 埃爾維格接替萬巴成為西哥德國王。

translation.original: Erwig succeeds Wamba as the King of the Visigoths.

events.title: 埃爾維格召開第十二次托雷多會議
events.summary: 埃爾維格召開第十二次托雷多會議，替自己的王位取得正當性，也修訂《西哥德法典》並打壓猶太人。

translation.original: The Twelfth Council of Toledo is summoned by Erwig to legitimize his power. It also revised the Visigothic Code and oppressed Jews.

events.title: 第十三次托雷多會議召開
events.summary: 第十三次托雷多會議召開，赦免了曾反叛國王萬巴和欽蒂拉的人。

translation.original: The Thirteenth Council of Toledo is convened, pardoning the rebels against King Wamba and King Chintila.

events.title: 教宗良二世要求確認第三次君士坦丁堡大公會議反對基督一志論的決議
events.summary: 教宗良二世要求確認第三次君士坦丁堡大公會議反對基督一志論的決議，第十四次托雷多會議召開並確認了這些決議。

translation.original: The Fourteenth Council of Toledo is convened, in response to a request by Pope Leo II to confirm the decisions of the ecumenical Third Council of Constantinople against monothelitism. The Council confirms the decisions of the Constantinople Council.

events.locationLabel: 第三次君士坦丁堡公會議

events.title: 埃爾維格去世
events.summary: 埃爾維格去世，指定女婿埃吉卡繼位為西哥德國王。

translation.original: King Erwig dies and appoints Egica, his son-in-law, as the successor King of the Visigoths.

events.title: 埃吉卡召開第十五次托雷多會議
events.summary: 埃吉卡召開第十五次托雷多會議，希望解除他保護埃爾維格子女的誓言；會議同意解除誓言，但沒有如他所願取消這些子女原有的保護。

translation.original: King Egica summons the Fifteenth Council of Toledo to reaffirm the XIV Council of Toledo and to release him from the duty to protect Erwig's children. The Council releases Egica from his oath to Erwig to protect his children, but do not revert the protection they had due to the XIII Council of Toledo, as King Egica had hoped.

events.title: 托雷多總主教西塞貝特起兵反對埃吉卡
events.summary: 托雷多總主教西塞貝特起兵反對埃吉卡，想擁立蘇涅弗雷德為王，但失敗了。

translation.original: Sisebert, the metropolitan of Toledo, led a rebellion against Egica in favor of raising a man named Suniefred to the throne. The rebellion would fail.

loc.title: Wikidata：天主教托萊多總教區
loc.note: 依原文提到的條目推算位置

events.title: 埃吉卡召開第十六次托雷多會議懲處前一年的叛亂
events.summary: 埃吉卡召開第十六次托雷多會議懲處前一年的叛亂，也修改《西哥德法典》，包括壓迫猶太人與同性戀的法律。

translation.original: King Egica summons the Sixteenth Council of Toledo to punish the rebellion of the previous year. The council also altered the Visigothic code, including laws repressing Jews and homosexuality.

events.title: 埃吉卡立兒子維蒂薩為共治君主
events.summary: 埃吉卡立兒子維蒂薩為共治君主。

translation.original: King Egica appoints his son, Wittiza, as co-ruler.

events.title: 埃吉卡去世
events.summary: 埃吉卡去世，維蒂薩成為唯一的統治者。

translation.original: King Egica dies, leaving his son Wittiza as sole ruler.

events.title: 欽達斯溫特的孫子羅德里克篡位
events.summary: 欽達斯溫特的孫子羅德里克篡位，常被稱為最後一位西哥德國王（正式說法是阿爾多）；西哥德王國分裂成支持羅德里克和支持阿希拉二世的兩派。

translation.original: Roderic, often known as the last king of the Visigoths (although officially that title belongs to Ardo), a grandson of Chindaswinth, usurps the throne. The Visigothic kingdom breaks into two factions, one (the provinces of Lusitania and western Carthaginiensis around the capital Toledo) in support of Roderic, the other in support of Achila II.

events.title: 伍麥亞王朝征服伊比利半島：塔里克率軍渡過直布羅陀海峽進入西哥德王國
events.summary: 伍麥亞王朝征服伊比利半島：塔里克率軍渡過直布羅陀海峽進入西哥德王國，國王羅德里克在瓜達萊特戰役中陣亡；到 716 年，伊比利半島大部分已在伊斯蘭統治下。

translation.original: The Umayyad conquest of Hispania begins with Tariq ibn Ziyad crossing the Strait of Gibraltar and entering the Visigothic Kingdom. King Roderic of the Visigoths dies in the Battle of Guadalete. By 716, most of the Iberian Peninsula is under Islamic rule.

events.title: 阿布杜勒－阿齊茲成為安達魯斯總督
events.summary: 阿布杜勒－阿齊茲成為安達魯斯總督，安達魯斯是伍麥亞王朝的一個省，名義上隸屬北非凱魯萬的總督，而不是直接聽命於大馬士革的哈里發。

translation.original: Abd al-Aziz ibn Musa becomes Governor of al-Andalus, with al-Andalus constituting a single province within the Umayyad Caliphate. Al-Andalus was formally a province subordinate to the Umayyad governor of Kairouan in Ifriqiya, rather than directly dependent on the Umayyad Caliph in Damascus, with Kairouan appointing most of the governors of al-Andalus.

events.title: 科瓦東加戰役後
events.summary: 科瓦東加戰役後，西哥德貴族佩拉約建立阿斯圖里亞斯王國，開啟阿斯圖里亞斯－萊昂王朝。

translation.original: Following the Battle of Covadonga, the Visigothic nobleman Pelagius of Asturias founds the Kingdom of Asturias. He begins the Astur-Leonese dynasty.

loc.title: Wikidata：科瓦東加戰役

events.title: 佩拉約去世
events.summary: 佩拉約去世，獨子法維拉成為阿斯圖里亞斯國王。

translation.original: Pelagius dies and Favila of Asturias, his only son, becomes King of the Asturias.

events.title: 法維拉打獵時被熊咬死
events.summary: 法維拉打獵時被熊咬死，由娶了佩拉約女兒的妹婿阿方索一世繼位。

translation.original: Favila is killed by a bear in a hunt and is succeeded by his brother-in-law, Alfonso I of Asturias, who had married Pelagius' daughter Ermesinda.

events.wiki: 阿方索一世 (阿斯圖里亞斯)
rel: 阿方索一世 (阿斯圖里亞斯)

events.title: 阿方索一世趁柏柏人起義占領加利西亞
events.summary: 阿方索一世趁柏柏人起義占領加利西亞；柏柏人起義從丹吉爾開始，起因是改信伊斯蘭的柏柏人受到不平等的課稅。

translation.original: Alfonso I of Asturias conquers Galicia, taking advantage of the Berber Revolt. The Berber revolt started in Tanger, led by Maysara al-Matghari, over unequal taxation treatment of Berber converts to Islam.

loc.title: Wikidata：加利西亞自治區

events.title: 柏柏人起義擴大到伊比利半島
events.summary: 柏柏人起義擴大到伊比利半島，杜羅河沿岸的柏柏駐軍叛變南下，讓阿方索一世得以向南擴張。

translation.original: The Berber Revolt expands into Iberia, with a mutiny by Berber garrisons on the Douro who form a rebel army and march South. This allowed Alfonso I to expand his kingdom southward.

loc.title: Wikidata：斗羅河
loc.note: 依原文提到的條目推算位置

events.title: 柏柏人起義結束
events.summary: 柏柏人起義結束，柏柏人在馬格里布西部和中部建立獨立政權，雖然沒拿下伊比利半島，卻切斷了它與伍麥亞王朝其他地區的聯繫；協助平亂的敘利亞軍隊留在伊比利半島。

translation.original: The Berber revolt ends, with a limited victory for the Berber who establish independent Berber polities in the western and central Maghreb. They had failed to take Iberia, but managed to cut if off from the rest of the Umayyad caliphate. Syrian troops who helped fight against the rebels remain in Iberia.

events.title: 伍麥亞王朝因阿拔斯革命垮台
events.summary: 伍麥亞王朝因阿拔斯革命垮台，747 年上任的安達魯斯總督優素福開始獨立統治。

translation.original: Yusuf ibn Abd al-Rahman al-Fihri, who had been appointed governor of al-Andalus in 747, rules independently, given the collapse of the Umayyad rule following the Abbasid revolution.

events.title: 阿拔斯革命後
events.summary: 阿拔斯革命後，伍麥亞王子阿布杜拉赫曼一世逃到安達魯斯。

translation.original: A Umayyad prince, Abd al-Rahman I, escapes to al-Andalus in the aftermath of the Abbasid revolution.

events.title: 阿布杜拉赫曼一世在阿拉梅達戰役擊敗總督優素福
events.summary: 阿布杜拉赫曼一世在阿拉梅達戰役擊敗總督優素福。

translation.original: Abd al-Rahman I defeats Yusuf ibn Abd al-Rahman al-Fihri in the Battle of Alameda.

events.title: 阿布杜拉赫曼一世建立哥多華酋長國
events.summary: 阿布杜拉赫曼一世建立哥多華酋長國，自任埃米爾。

translation.original: Abd al-Rahman I proclaims the Emirate of Córdoba with himself as the Emir.

events.title: 阿方索一世去世
events.summary: 阿方索一世去世，長子弗魯埃拉一世繼位，他鎮壓加利西亞的反抗，使當地殘破不堪。

translation.original: After the death of Alfonso I of Asturias, Fruela I of Asturias, his older son, ascends to the throne. He would suppress uprisings in Galicia, laying waste to the Galician country.

events.title: 控制大馬士革的阿拔斯王朝派阿拉為安達魯斯總督
events.summary: 控制大馬士革的阿拔斯王朝派阿拉為安達魯斯總督，他在貝雅設立政府，卻無法掌控安達魯斯，最後被阿布杜拉赫曼一世的軍隊殺死。

translation.original: The Abbasid, who now control Damascus, appoint Al-Ala ibn Mughith al-Judhami as governor of al-Andalus. He would set his government in Beja, but would be unsuccessful in gaining control of al-Andalus, being killed in battle by the forces of Abd al-Rahman I.

events.title: 弗魯埃拉一世因殺害親弟弟而遭部下不滿、被暗殺
events.summary: 弗魯埃拉一世因殺害親弟弟而遭部下不滿、被暗殺，由堂兄弟奧雷利奧繼位。

translation.original: Fruela I is assassinated by his own men, as a result of their discontentment over the fact he killed his own brother Vimarano, and is succeeded by his cousin, Aurelius of Asturias.

rel: 奧雷利歐 (阿斯圖里亞斯)

events.title: 奧雷利奧自然死亡
events.summary: 奧雷利奧自然死亡，由娶了阿方索一世女兒的西洛繼位，西洛再次平定加利西亞的反抗。

translation.original: Aurelius dies of natural causes and is succeeded by his cousin-in-law, Silo of Asturias, the husband of Alfonso I's daughter Adosinda. Silo would stamp down a second rebel revolt in Galicia.

events.title: 阿拔斯王朝派第二位總督去和阿布杜拉赫曼一世爭奪安達魯斯
events.summary: 阿拔斯王朝派第二位總督去和阿布杜拉赫曼一世爭奪安達魯斯，同樣失敗，這也是大馬士革最後一次任命安達魯斯總督。

translation.original: The Abbasid appoint a second governor, Abd al-Rahman ibn Habib al-Siqlabi, to dispute control of al-Andalus against Abd al-Rahman I. Ibn Ḥabīb was also unsuccessful and was the last al-Andalus governor appointed by Damascus.

events.title: 西洛去世
events.summary: 西洛去世，由阿方索二世繼位，但他隨即被貴族廢黜，改立他的叔叔毛雷加托。

translation.original: Silo dies and is succeeded by Alfonso II of Asturias, although immediately deposed by the nobility in favor of his uncle Mauregatus.

events.title: 阿方索二世去世
events.summary: 阿方索二世去世，由拉米羅一世繼位；因為拉米羅一世不在首都，內波提安在部分貴族支持下篡位，但拉米羅一世回來後很快就擊敗他。

translation.original: Alfonso II dies and is succeeded by Ramiro I of Asturias. Because Ramiro I was not in the capital, Nepotian of Asturias, with the support of some members the nobility, usurped the throne but quickly lost militarily against Ramiro I's allies upon his return.

translation.original: First Viking raid of Lisbon, who occupied the city for 13 days. The governor of Lisbon, Wahballah ibn Hazm, wrote about the attack to the Emir.

translation.original: Ramiro I dies and is succeeded by his son Ordoño I of Asturias, becoming the first king of Asturias to ascend the throne without election by nobility (in contrast to the Visigothic tradition).

events.title: 伊斯蘭統治期間
events.summary: 伊斯蘭統治期間，基督徒大多屬於「受保護的人」，可以私下信仰，但哥多華埃米爾在 850 到 859 年間處決了 48 名基督徒，史稱哥多華殉道者，其中至少兩位出生於今天的葡萄牙貝雅。

translation.original: While during most Islamic rule Christians were considered part of the Dhimmi, and thus allowed to exist and worship in private, the Emirs of Córdoba would execute 48 Christians between 850 and 859, known collectively as the Martyrs of Córdoba. The Martyrs included at least two Mozarabs born in present-day Portugal: Sisenandus of Beja (patron saint of Beja) and a priest named Elias, also from Beja, executed with two of his students.

translation.original: Vímara Peres was made count of Portugal by Alfonso III of Asturias, king of Asturias, after conquering from the Emirate of Córdoba the Atlantic coast between the Minho and Douro rivers.

translation.original: The Muridun ("Disciples") under Abul-Qasim Ahmad ibn al-Husayn al-Qasi rebel in the Algarve. Ibn al-Mundhir takes Silves in his name and the governor of Beja, Sidray ibn Wazir, also supports him. Ibn al-Mundhir and Sidray ibn Wazir kill the garrison of Monchique castle, and 70 men take Mértola by surprise (12 Aug). Soon after the Andalusian governor of Niebla, Yusuf ibn Ahmad al-Bitruji declares for the Muridun. The Almoravid Yahya ibn Ali ibn Ghaniya drives the Muridun back from Seville, and subsequently Sidray ibn Wazir splits off from the other Muridun.

events.title: 一小群密謀者衝進里斯本王宮
events.summary: 一小群密謀者衝進里斯本王宮，推翻葡萄牙總督薩伏依的瑪格麗特；葡萄牙最高貴族布拉干薩公爵在民眾擁戴和妻子勸說下，勉強接受王位，成為若昂四世。他整個在位期間都在為脫離西班牙獨立而奮鬥。

translation.original: A small group of conspirators storms the Palace in Lisbon and deposes the Vicereine of Portugal, Margaret of Savoy. The Duke of Bragança, head of the senior family of the Portuguese nobility (and descended from a bastard of João I), accepts the throne as Dom João IV of Portugal, despite deep personal reluctance, by popular acclaim and at the urging of his wife. His entire reign will be dominated by the struggle to maintain independence from Spain. Francisco de Lucena, secretary to the governing council of Portugal for the past 36 years and thus the most experienced bureaucrat in the country, smoothly changes his loyalties and becomes chief minister of the restored monarchy.

translation.original: The Portuguese Inquisition attempts to derail the national restoration by giving its support to a counter-revolution mounted by a duke, a marquis, three earls and an archbishop. The plot fails, quelled by Francisco de Lucena, who has the ringleaders executed, but it initiates a 28-year-long war against Spain punctuated by frequent internal threats to the stability of the new regime. Meanwhile, the Dutch renew their attack on Angola and capture the most extensive Portuguese slaving grounds in Africa, including the Angolan port of Luanda. The Portuguese garrison flees upriver while trying to decide whether to declare continuing loyalty to the Habsburgs, accept Dutch rule or declare for João IV. They choose the House of Bragança and appeal to the Portuguese colony of Brazil for help in fending off African and Dutch attacks on their enclave. Salvador de Sá, leader of Rio de Janeiro, persuaded by the Jesuits in Brazil, also declares for King João and responds to the Angolan appeal.

Portugal is allowed to recruit soldiers and horses in England for the fight against Spain; and to seek out 4,000 fighting men in Scotland and Ireland and charter 24 English ships to carry them. The expeditionary force is to be issued with English weapons on arrival in Portugal and guaranteed religious freedom of worship.

translation.original: Catarina da Bragança, sister of Afonso VI, marries Charles II of Great Britain on 31 May. She brings to London a dowry of 2,000,000 gold pieces, the practice of drinking afternoon tea, and England is given colonial toe-holds in the Portuguese Empire at Tangier and Bombay, per the Marriage Treaty. Servicing the wedding debt burdens the Portuguese exchequer for the next half-century, and this marriage with a Protestant monarch is deeply unpopular with that section of the Portuguese nobility which favours alliance with France.

translation.original: In a palace coup d’etat in Lisbon a restive younger faction of the nobility, supported by the young Afonso VI, overthrows the Queen Regent and installs the 26-year-old Count of Castelo Melhor as 'dictator' to prosecute the war with Spain. The adolescent king is married to a French princess and the young dictator models his government on the royal absolutism of the Bourbon dynasty. Opposition to this pro-French absolutism (from the King's sister the Queen of England, and his younger brother Prince Pedro) is swept aside, and Castelo Melhor initiates the final, successful phase of the Portuguese war of restoration with the aid of the Franco-German Marshal Schomberg, who brilliantly commands an international mercenary army against the Spanish forces.

events.summary: 和西班牙簽訂和約，結束將近 30 年的戰爭；葡萄牙保住所有領土，只把摩洛哥的休達割讓給西班牙。但葡萄牙經濟仍然衰弱，依賴英國的穀物和布料，於是在科維良設立紡織工廠，卻不受歡迎；發展絲綢業的嘗試也遭到法國強力阻撓。

translation.original: Peace treaty with Spain ends nearly 30 years of war. Portugal keeps all his possessions and territory with the exception of Ceuta in Morocco, which is ceded to Spain. Portugal remains economically weak, however, agriculturally undeveloped and dependent on British grain and trade goods generally, especially woven cloth. The Count of Ericeira, economic adviser to the Prince Regent, advocates the development of a native textile industry modelled on Flemish lines. 'Factories' are established at Covilhã with easy access to flocks of sheep and clean mountain water, but are highly unpopular with both town consumers and traditional weavers. Meanwhile, Portuguese attempts to develop a silk industry are fiercely resisted by the French, who wish to monopolise that market.

translation.original: Sir John Methuen negotiates a Military Treaty with Portugal on 16 May, giving Britain an entry to Portugal at a time when the Bourbon dynastic alliance of France and Spain appears to threaten English access to the Continent. This is followed on 27 December by the commercial Methuen Treaty, signed to stimulate trade with Britain. This (which lasts until 1810) opens up new markets for Portuguese wine but helps to destroy the native textile industry by letting in British cloth at preferential rates. The fashion for Portuguese wine in Britain (which has banned the import of French wine due to the War of the Spanish Succession, which will last until 1714) makes the wine trade so profitable and competitive that over the next 40 years inferior wines, often adulterated and artificially coloured are passed off as the genuine article – giving 'port' a bad name.

events.summary: 若昂五世成為葡萄牙國王；靠著巴西黃金的巨大財富，葡萄牙藝術與文化蓬勃發展，王室成為歐洲最富有的家族，他仿效法國國王建立君主專制、大興土木，卻忽略了貧困的農業、交通和工業。同時巴西的淘金熱引發葡萄牙移民與聖保羅人之間的內戰。

translation.original: João V of Portugal becomes king. He presides over a great flowering of Portuguese art and culture underpinned by the fabulous wealth provided by Brazilian gold. Social and economic reform are neglected for the next 40 years, and the pious King indulges in a penchant for fabulously expensive building. The Portuguese royal family is now the wealthiest in Europe and João V even considers moving his throne and court to Rio de Janeiro. The taxation of the Brazilian trade brings in an enormous personal revenue to the monarch and he is able to construct an absolutist regime similar to that of the French Kings, concentrating on pomp and ceremony at court. There is however no attention to the impoverished national agriculture, inadequate transport, neglected merchant navy and minimal industrial development of the country since corn and cloth can easily be exported, foreign ships can be hired and 'every problem in Portugal can be solved by the King's gift of a little basket of gold coins bearing his effigy'. Meanwhile, the Brazilian gold rush continues and civil war breaks out between the mining camps of Portuguese immigrants lately come to the north of the country and the Paulistas of southern Brazil who discovered the gold in the first place.

The scale of the buildings and formal gardens is stupendous in relation to the impoverished countryside around it. Designed by the papal architect Vanvitelli, and using the most costly materials available including ivory, agate, porphyry and lapis lazuli, the chapel is erected in the Vatican in order that the Pope may celebrate Mass in it before it is dismantled and shipped to Portugal.

events.summary: 里斯本大地震：11 月 1 日諸聖節上午 9 點半，地震摧毀里斯本大部分地區，以及阿連特如、阿爾加維許多城鎮；十分鐘內三次強震，教堂蠟燭引發的大火和巨大海嘯造成里斯本 27 萬人口中約 4 萬人死亡。伏爾泰在《憨第德》中描寫這場災難；龐巴爾侯爵隨即主持重建，以棋盤式街道把里斯本重建為歐洲最好的城市。

translation.original: The Great earthquake of Portugal is the most shattering natural phenomenon of the Age of Enlightenment. Striking at 9.30 am on All Saints' Day (1 November), it destroys much of Lisbon and many towns in parts of the Alentejo and Algarve (Faro, Lagos and Albufeira are devastated). In Lisbon, three major shocks within ten minutes, a host of rapidly spreading fires touched off by the candles of a hundred church altars, and a vast tsunami that engulfs the seafront, leave 40,000 dead out of a total population of 270,000. The Alfama district of the old city is largely untouched owing to its situation on a rocky massif, as is Belém. The Customs House is flooded and the India House and the English Factory destroyed, so that no trade can legitimately be conducted. The King proves himself able in crisis management and his illegitimate half-brothers, the royal dukes, organise defence, security, the burying of the dead and the continuance of religious observance. The disaster is described by Voltaire in Candide. Rebuilding begins immediately under the vigorous direction of Pombal, who now consolidates his position as Portugal's enlightened despot and leading statesman. It is decided to reconstruct Lisbon as the finest city in Europe, on the grid plan already adopted in the leading cities of Spanish America.

translation.original: João VI lands in Portugal, but only after consenting to the restrictions on his power proposed by the Cortes and agreeing to accept the new constitution. His wife Queen Carlota Joaquina and younger son Dom Miguel refuse to do so and become the focus of a reactionary movement.

events.summary: 軍事政變：龐巴爾侯爵的孫子薩爾達尼亞擔心法國干預或爆發內戰，帶兵把「激進立憲派」趕出里斯本，提出部分恢復王權的折衷憲法（這是他一生七次政變的第一次）。

translation.original: Military coup against the parliamentarians. Fearing a move by France against democratic Portugal, or a civil war, Brigadier Saldanha, a grandson of the Marquis of Pombal, raises a small army and expels the 'constitutional extremists' from Lisbon. He proposes instead a compromise constitution in which the powers of the crown will be partially restored to the King. (This is the first of Saldanha's seven coups d'état in his career).

events.summary: 佩德羅四世以巴西憲法為藍本，制定比 1820 年憲法保守的新憲法（1826 年憲章），讓國王在立法、行政、司法之間居中調節，並設立由 72 位貴族和 19 位主教組成的上議院；在維也納的米格爾表面上表示同意。

translation.original: Pedro IV of Portugal draws up a new constitution, somewhat less liberal than that of 1820 and based upon the Brazilian constitution, and invites all parties to accept it. This constitution (the Charter of 1826) assigns authority to the crown to moderate between the legislative, executive and judicial powers of the state and proposes a House of Lords of 72 aristocrats and 19 bishops. Miguel (in Vienna) makes a show of agreement.

translation.original: Miguel returns to Portugal, ostensibly to take the oath of allegiance to the Charter and assume the regency. He was immediately proclaimed king by his supporters, who pressed him to return to absolutism.

translation.original: Emperor Pedro I of Brazil abdicates in favour of his son Pedro II of Brazil and sets out to regain Portugal for his daughter.

events.title: 佩德羅率領葡萄牙流亡者和外國傭兵在特塞拉島集結

translation.original: Pedro's expeditionary force of Portuguese exiles and foreign mercenaries gathers in Terceira, regains the Azores, then sails for Portugal. Pedro is supported by Britain and France and the Portuguese intelligentsia, including the politically ambitious soldiers Saldanha and Sá da Bandeira.

events.title: 佩德羅在波多北邊登陸
events.summary: 佩德羅在波多北邊登陸，被約 1 萬 3000 名米格爾派軍隊圍困，波多城飽受霍亂、飢餓和炮擊之苦。

translation.original: Pedro lands at Pampelido north of Porto, where he is closely besieged by some 13,000 Miguelites across the River Douro. His defending force, the city garrison being commanded by Sá da Bandeira, includes an international brigade with a British contingent under Charles Shaw and Colonel George Lloyd Hodges. The city suffers cholera, starvation and bombardment.

events.summary: 特塞拉公爵贏得阿塞伊塞拉戰役，米格爾 5 月 26 日投降，內戰結束，米格爾流亡熱那亞；六年戰爭讓國家再次破產，國家沒收占國土四分之一的王室土地來償還國債。

translation.original: The Duke of Terceira wins the Battle of Asseiceira. Miguel capitulates at EvoraMonte on 26 May. End of the civil war: Miguel is exiled to Genoa, where he renounces his capitulation. For many years he plots his return, but is never able to put it into effect. After six years of bitter and destructive war the country is once again bankrupt and beholden to foreign creditors, and the constitutional radicals turn their anger against the landowners and ecclesiastical institutions that had supported Miguel. The crown lands (a quarter of the national territory) are taken over by the state to help pay the national debt.

Dissolution of the monasteries – over 300 monastic communities are abolished – however the sale of church and crown lands does not revitalise Portugal in the way that had been anticipated.

events.summary: 城市暴動和軍事政變再度點燃革命熱潮，國民衛隊支持起事者，要求薩達班德拉領導國家、恢復 1822 年憲法；瑪麗亞女王被迫宣誓效忠 1822 年憲法，溫和派薩爾達尼亞與薩達班德拉達成妥協，開始推動小規模現代化。

translation.original: Revolutionary fervour is rekindled by an urban uprising and a military coup d’etat. The national Guard sides with the insurgents and approved the call for Sá da Bandeira to lead the nation and bring back the constitution of 1822. Queen Maria is forced to swear allegiance to the 1822 constitution but the moderate leader, Saldanha, reaches an accommodation with Sá da Bandeira and a modest programme of modernisation can begin.

events.title: 瑪麗亞‧達豐特革命：米尼奧地區的農民（主要由婦女帶頭）起來反抗科斯塔‧卡布拉爾政府的圈地和新土地稅
events.summary: 瑪麗亞‧達豐特革命：米尼奧地區的農民（主要由婦女帶頭）起來反抗科斯塔‧卡布拉爾政府的圈地和新土地稅，卡布拉爾政府倒台；秋天波多成立以薩達班德拉為首的革命政府，女王支持者和激進立憲派爆發內戰。

translation.original: The Revolution of Maria da Fonte, a 'peasants' revolt' inaugurates the last phase of the Revolution, starting as an uprising of the peasants of the Minho, largely led by women (their movement is named after the semi-mythical 'Maria da Fonte') against land enclosures and new land taxes demanded by the Costa Cabral government to finance its grandiose public works. They make common cause with the clergy and call for the return of the exiled Miguel as their saviour. Martial law is declared but soldiers refuse to fire on their kin. Fall of the Costa Cabral government and substitution of a government of national reconciliation in Lisbon. Autumn: A revolutionary government is proclaimed in Porto with Sá da Bandeira at its head. He opens negotiations with Britain, whence Costa Cabral has fled into exile, and settles terms for his return to take responsibility for the national debt. Civil war between the supporters of Queen Maria and the radical constitutionalists. The Count of Bonfim, for the Porto junta, is defeated by Saldanha at the siege of Torres Vedras and exiled to Angola.

events.title: 薩爾達尼亞再次政變
events.summary: 薩爾達尼亞再次政變，趕走科斯塔‧卡布拉爾，自任首相執政五年，終於建立兩黨輪替的議會政治；葡萄牙進入「復興時期」，政府大舉興建公共工程，設立現代郵政，並每年修建 200 公里道路（當時全國全天候可通行的道路不到 200 公里）。

translation.original: Another coup d’etat by Saldanha. He ejects Costa Cabral, appoints himself prime minister and rules reasonably progressively from the house of lords for a full five-year term. Thus a proper parliamentary regime is finally established, with a two-party system and a bourgeois monarchy. Portugal enters its Age of Regeneration, with an old-fashioned cavalry officer in charge. The government embarks on an elaborate programme of public works to modernise the country, beginning with the establishment of a modern post office and a programme of road-building: in the entire country there is less than 200 km of all-weather road surface, and the government uses road taxes to finance 200 km of new road per year.

translation.original: Despite choosing to stay away from the World War I, the death of King Carol I and the course of events made Romania to change its view and decide to switch sides in favor of the Entente, demanding the territory of the Kingdom of Hungary of until the Tisza River. The demands of the Romanian Government were accepted and following the First Treaty of Bucharest. Romania declare war to the Central Powers on 27 August and launches attacks against Kingdom of Hungary through the Southern Carpathians and into Transylvania. Poorly trained and equipped, the Romanian Army cannot face the power of the Austro-Hungarian, German, Bulgarian and Ottoman armies and Bucharest was occupied on 6 December 1916 by the Central Powers. Iași becomes temporarily the capital city of Romania.

translation.original: The Hungarian army was disarmed on 2 November, and Austria-Hungary signed the armistice on 3 November 1918. One day before the German armistice, Romania re-entered the war on 10 November with similar objectives to those of 1916. On 12 November, the Romanian army crossed the Hungarian border and entered in Transylvania. On 28 November the Romanian representatives of Bucovina voted for union with the Kingdom of Romania, followed by the proclamation of the union of Transylvania with the Kingdom of Romania on 1 December, by the representatives of Transylvanian Romanians and of the Transylvanian Saxons gathered at Alba Iulia. The declaration included 26 counties of the Kingdom of Hungary, the territory until the Tisza River, Banat, and Máramaros county. Both proclamations were not, however, yet recognized by the Entente powers.

translation.original: On December 16, protests break out in Timișoara. Five days later Nicolae Ceaușescu organises a mass meeting in Bucharest. translation.original: A 20,000 strong Serbian army led by Prince Lazar Hrebeljanović of Rascia, Vlatko Vuković of Bosnia, Miloš Obilić and most other prominent nobles faced the better equipped and trained Ottoman army in the Battle of Kosovo. Most of the Empire was now in Ottoman hands save for the Serbian Despotate, Montenegro and Bosnia which soon followed.

Catholic Belgrade is now the only bastion of Christianity in the Balkans. Massive reconstruction of the city is under way.

translation.original: Holy Roman Empress Maria Theresa gives royal city rights to Novi Sad, the biggest Serbian settlement in this Empire, following the capitulation of Habsburg Serbia. The city becomes known as Serbian Athens and a place of Serbian national revival. Most of Serbian culture, including its patriarchy (Metropolitanate of Karlovci), is now "in exile" across the Danube and Sava rivers overlooking Ottoman Serbia to the south. More Serbian cities are granted a Free Royal Status in years to come chiefly by Maria Theresa of Austria: Sombor, Bečkerek, Subotica (Maria-Theresiopolis), etc.

Foreign Minister Shehu is attacked by demonstrators there on January 25. On January 26, thousands of people converge on central Tirana and clash with riot police. events.title: 全國進入緊急狀態
events.summary: 全國進入緊急狀態，暴動群眾占領南部城鎮，奪走警察和軍隊的武器。

translation.original: A national state of emergency is declared. Rioters take control of the town of Sarandë, seizing weapons from police headquarters and army barracks. With astonishing speed the entire military establishment melts away, the security service dissolves, and the people arm themselves with every type of weapon, including Kalashnikovs and even tanks – an estimated 650,000 weapons are seized. Most of the southern half of the country falls into the hands of ragtag rebels and criminal gangs. More than 10,000 persons flee to Italy, which in turn causes a governmental crisis in Rome. Several high government officials, including Defense Minister Safet Zhulali, flee abroad.

events.summary: 國會通過新憲法草案，並在公投中獲得通過。

translation.original: Albania's parliament votes in favour of a draft constitution and agrees to put it to a referendum. This is held on November 22, and 93.5% of the voters support the new constitution. Turnout is 50.6%. President Meidani signs the constitution into law on November 28, Albania's independence day. The new constitution, which replaces a package of laws introduced after the collapse of communism, provides for the separation of powers, rule of law, and the independence of the judiciary. It also guarantees human rights and the protection of minorities. The opposition Democratic Party, which (ignoring calls by the Organization for Security and Cooperation in Europe and the Council of Europe) boycotted the referendum and the parliamentary commission which drafted the constitution, says the results were fixed and that it can not recognize the new constitution.

events.title: 北約轟炸南斯拉夫期間
events.summary: 北約轟炸南斯拉夫期間，約45萬名科索沃難民逃到阿爾巴尼亞。

translation.original: During the 78 days of NATO bombing of Yugoslavia, about 450,000 of a total 750,000 Kosovar refugees flee into Albania. That figure is equal to almost 15% of Albania's total population. The hostilities turn Albania into a key operational theatre for international relief agencies and NATO forces in Albania, called Kosovo Force (KFOR), which launch a humanitarian relief operation. In addition, within the framework of the NATO air campaign, U.S. forces deploy 24 Apache antitank helicopters and long-range artillery pieces in northern Albania. The northern Albanian border regions of Kukës and Tropojë bear the brunt of the refugee influx and military operations. Supplying the refugees and transporting them to other parts of the country creates immense logistic difficulties for the United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees and other relief agencies. The region also sees ongoing border clashes between Yugoslav forces, who continually shell Albanian border villages, and Kosovo Liberation Army (KLA) fighters operating in part from support bases inside Albania. The border area remains heavily mined after the fighting subsides. With the end of the fighting, Albania's relations improve with its neighbours – Montenegro, Macedonia, Greece, and the new UN administration in Kosovo, with whom the Albanian Foreign Ministry plans a series of joint regional development projects within the framework of the European Union-funded Stability Pact for South Eastern Europe. Early accomplishments include the installation of a powerful microwave-telephone connection between Albania and Kosovo and the signing of infrastructure development projects with Montenegro. (to June)

translation.original: The colonisation of the Maltese Islands by the Phoenicians begins. Earliest evidence of commerce and increased contacts with surrounding Mediterranean cultures. The Phoenicians were present on Malta, which they called Ann, before the end of the 2nd millennium BC.

events.title: 馬爾他歸迦太基控制
events.summary: 馬爾他歸迦太基控制，很快成為迦太基的海軍基地。

translation.original: The islands come under the control of Carthage, a former Phoenician colony, and rapidly develop into a Carthaginian naval base, also shown by numerous Carthaginian coins found in Malta. A number of Greek coins from Athens and Corinth indicate a peaceful coexistence with Greeks in Malta and trade with Greek settlements in Eastern Sicily.

events.title: 馬爾他被併入羅馬共和國
events.summary: 馬爾他被併入羅馬共和國，屬於西西里行省。

translation.original: Malta is incorporated into the Roman Republic, within the province of Sicily.

events.title: 聖保羅在馬爾他島遭遇船難
events.summary: 聖保羅在馬爾他島遭遇船難。

translation.original: Saint Paul shipwrecked on the island.

events.title: 貝利撒留讓馬爾他群島回歸拜占庭帝國
events.summary: 貝利撒留讓馬爾他群島回歸拜占庭帝國，統治約三百年。

translation.original: Belisarius restores the Maltese Islands to the Byzantine Empire for the next three hundred years.

events.title: 馬爾他被北非的阿拉伯人（阿格拉布王朝）征服
events.summary: 馬爾他被北非的阿拉伯人（阿格拉布王朝）征服。

translation.original: Malta is conquered by Aghlabid Arabs.

events.title: 阿拉伯人帶來改良的農業和灌溉技術
events.summary: 阿拉伯人帶來改良的農業和灌溉技術，例如水車，也引進棉花和柑橘。

translation.original: Improved agriculture and irrigation systems are introduced, including the 'noria' or waterwheel; cotton and citrus fruits are introduced to Malta.

events.title: 諾曼人西西里伯爵羅傑一世入侵馬爾他
events.summary: 諾曼人西西里伯爵羅傑一世入侵馬爾他，島上的穆斯林談判後和平投降。

translation.original: The Norman Count Roger I of Sicily invades Malta and the Muslim inhabitants negotiate a peaceful surrender. Gozo is sacked by the Normans.

events.title: 基督教重新成為馬爾他群島的主要宗教
events.summary: 基督教重新成為馬爾他群島的主要宗教。

translation.original: Christianity re-established as the Islands' dominant religion.

events.title: 馬爾他和西西里由亞拉岡王國統治（到1530年）
events.summary: 馬爾他和西西里由亞拉岡王國統治（到1530年）。

translation.original: Malta and Sicily are ruled by the Crown of Aragon. (to 1530)

events.title: 馬爾他成立地方自治機構「大學」
events.summary: 馬爾他成立地方自治機構「大學」。

translation.original: Establishment of the Università, a form of local government, in Malta.

events.title: 亞拉岡國王阿方索把馬爾他直接納入王室領地
events.summary: 亞拉岡國王阿方索把馬爾他直接納入王室領地，並承諾永遠不把馬爾他封給別人。

translation.original: King Alfonso incorporates Malta to the Crown of Aragon (Kingdom of Sicily), and promises never to grant Malta as a fief to any third party.

events.title: 鄂圖曼蘇丹蘇萊曼一世把醫院騎士團趕出羅德島
events.summary: 鄂圖曼蘇丹蘇萊曼一世把醫院騎士團趕出羅德島。

translation.original: Suleiman I drives the Military Hospitaller Knights of St. John of Jerusalem out of Rhodes.

translation.original: In an effort to protect Rome from Islamic invasion, Emperor Charles V grants the Maltese Islands to the Knights of St. John of Jerusalem in perpetual fief.

translation.original: Governor of Gozo Galatian de Sesse surrenders the Castello to Sinan Pasha; the majority of the island's inhabitants (some 5,000 to 7,000 people) are enslaved and are taken to North Africa and later to Constantinople.

events.summary: 鄂圖曼大艦隊出現在馬爾他外海，馬爾他大圍城開始。

translation.original: Turkish forces retreat from Malta.

events.title: 馬爾他新首都瓦萊塔建立
events.summary: 馬爾他新首都瓦萊塔建立，各地的防禦工事也全面加強。

translation.original: The founding of Malta's new capital city, Valletta. A general strengthening of Malta's fortifications is undertaken.

events.title: 瘟疫大流行
events.summary: 瘟疫大流行，約11,300人死亡。

translation.original: A plague epidemic begins, killing around 11,300 people until its end in August 1676.

events.title: 瓦萊塔的曼努埃爾劇院開幕
events.summary: 瓦萊塔的曼努埃爾劇院開幕。

translation.original: The Manoel Theatre (then known as the Teatro Pubblico) opens in Valletta with a performance of Scipione Maffei's classic tragedy Merope.
