events.title: 拿破崙入侵馬爾他
events.summary: 拿破崙入侵馬爾他。

translation.original: Napoleon invades Malta. Mdina (Notbile) capitulates on 10 June. The act of capitulation of Mdina is signed on the one part by Vincenzo Barbara representing the French Republic and the Hakem together with the jurats representing the people.

events.title: 馬爾他騎士團向拿破崙投降
events.summary: 馬爾他騎士團向拿破崙投降。

translation.original: The Order capitulates. The Act of capitulation of Malta is signed on 12 June by on the one part by Napoleon on behalf of the French Republic, on the other six signed on behalf of the Order, the people of Malta and the King of Spain.

events.title: 馬爾他廢除奴隸制度、宗教裁判所和所有貴族頭銜
events.summary: 馬爾他廢除奴隸制度、宗教裁判所和所有貴族頭銜。

translation.original: Slavery, the Roman Inquisition, and all titles of nobility are abolished in Malta.

events.title: 法軍大肆掠奪教堂
events.summary: 法軍大肆掠奪教堂，馬爾他人起來反抗法國，英國將馬爾他納入保護。

translation.original: Maltese uprising against the French following extensive pillaging of Maltese churches and cathedrals. Britain takes Malta under its protection, in the name of the Kingdom of the Two Sicilies. The Union Jack flies over Valletta for the first time, alongside the Neapolitan flag.

events.summary: 法軍投降。

translation.original: The French surrender. General Vaubois surrendered and with Rear Admiral Villeneuve, Major General Pigot and Captain Martin, signed the articles of Capitulation. Although 20,000 Maltese died during the uprising, not one Maltese was present to sign the document. Malta and Gozo become a Protectorate.

translation.original: Under the Treaty of Paris, and subsequently ratified by the Congress of Vienna, Malta status as a British Crown Colony is confirmed.

translation.original: Opening of the Suez Canal. This greatly enhanced the importance of the Grand Harbour to British merchant marine and naval shipping.

translation.original: The Malta Railway service is inaugurated, with service from Valletta to Floriana, Ħamrun, Msida, Birkirkara, Lija, San Antonio, Attard, Mosta (San Salvatore), and Mdina.

events.title: 「六月七日事件」：民眾抗議麵包漲價
events.summary: 「六月七日事件」：民眾抗議麵包漲價，英國士兵開槍打死四名馬爾他人。

translation.original: Sette Giugno protests over increases in the price of bread. British soldiers fire on the crowd and kill four Maltese protesters, during a violent riot instigated by students. The protests lead to greater autonomy for the Maltese.

events.title: 1921年憲法頒布
events.summary: 1921年憲法頒布，馬爾他得到自治權。

translation.original: Constitution of 1921 is promulgated, and it grants autonomy by providing for a bicameral legislature with the power to legislate on all matters not considered "reserved" for colonial interest.

events.title: 英語和馬爾他語被定為官方語言
events.summary: 英語和馬爾他語被定為官方語言，取代原本政府使用的義大利語。

translation.original: English and Maltese are declared the official languages of Malta, to the exclusion of Italian which had been the primary language of government, commerce, education and culture in Malta for more than 800 years.

events.title: 馬爾他第一次遭到空襲
events.summary: 馬爾他第一次遭到空襲，此後承受了二次大戰中最猛烈、最持久的轟炸。

translation.original: First air raids on Malta. Malta would go on to endure the heaviest, sustained bombing attack of the War: some 154 days and nights and 6,700 tons of bombs.

events.title: 英王喬治六世頒授喬治十字勳章給馬爾他
events.summary: 英王喬治六世頒授喬治十字勳章給馬爾他，表彰全體人民的英勇。

translation.original: The George Cross is awarded to Malta by King George VI, so as to "bear witness to the heroism and devotion of its people".

events.title: 馬爾他人民在兩年轟炸後幾乎斷糧
events.summary: 馬爾他人民在兩年轟炸後幾乎斷糧，「基座行動」的船隊終於突破封鎖送來補給。

translation.original: With the people of Malta near starvation after two years of virtually constant bombardment, Operation Pedestal brings the "Santa Marija Convoy" to Malta, saving the Islands from a planned surrender to the Axis powers.

translation.original: The Italian fleet's surrender in Malta is signed by U.S. General Dwight D. Eisenhower and Italian Marshal Pietro Badoglio.

translation.original: Malta Conference (1945); President Franklin D. Roosevelt of the United States and Prime Minister Winston Churchill of the United Kingdom meet on Malta to plan the final campaign against the Germans with the combined Chiefs of Staff, and to prepare for the Yalta Conference. (to 3 February)

translation.original: A referendum is held on the integration of Malta into the United Kingdom: 75% vote 'Yes'; however, the result is deemed to be questionable due to a boycott by 40% of the electorate in response to concerns raised by opposition parties and by the Catholic Church.

events.title: 馬爾他脫離英國獨立
events.summary: 馬爾他脫離英國獨立，成為君主立憲國家，以英國女王伊莉莎白二世為元首。

translation.original: Malta is granted independence from the United Kingdom as a Constitutional Monarchy, with Queen Elizabeth II as its Head of State.

events.title: 馬爾他加入聯合國
events.summary: 馬爾他加入聯合國。

translation.original: Malta joins the United Nations.

events.title: 馬爾他成為共和國
events.summary: 馬爾他成為共和國。

translation.original: Malta becomes a Republic, with the last Governor-General, Sir Anthony Mamo, serving as its first President. Malta remains a member of the Commonwealth of Nations.

events.title: 英國、希臘和土耳其簽訂《保證條約》
events.summary: 英國、希臘和土耳其簽訂《保證條約》，賽普勒斯成為大英國協內的獨立國家。

translation.original: The British, Greek and Turkish governments signed a Treaty of Guarantee to provide for an independent Cypriot state within the Commonwealth of Nations and allow for the retention of two Sovereign Base Areas at Akrotiri and Dhekelia. Under the treaty, each power received the right to take military action in the face of any threat to the constitution. Cyprus became independent of foreign rule. The Greek Cypriot Archbishop Makarios became the first president, with Turkish Cypriot Dr. Kutchuk his vice president. Both had the right of veto. Turkish Cypriots, who formed 18% of the population, were guaranteed the vice-presidency, three out of ten ministerial posts and 30% of jobs in the public service. They were further guaranteed 40% representation in the army and separate municipal services in the five major towns. Overall, a very complex constitution was drafted, which demanded a majority of votes overall as well as within each community for many decisions.
